issue.title: Add a Reset button to the counter page
issue.body: The counter page needs a "Reset" button next to the +1 and -1 buttons. Clicking it sets the displayed count back to 0. Put the logic in `src/counter.mjs` as a `reset()` method with a test, and wire the button up in `index.html`.

triage.reason: The issue specifies the method name, the target file, the reset-to-0 behavior, and the button location, and the change is confined to one method, one test, and one button in three small files. The existing node:test suite can verify it.
triage.plan: src/counter.mjs: add reset() { value = 0; }, setting to literal 0 rather than start. test/counter.test.mjs: add a test that increments, calls reset(), and asserts value is 0. index.html: add a <button id="reset">Reset</button> between -1 and +1 whose onclick calls counter.reset() then render(), matching the existing handlers. Verify with npm test.

uiCheck.summary: Page shows -1, Reset and +1 buttons. After three +1 clicks the count was 3, and clicking Reset returned it to 0. The screenshot is saved in the workspace root as ui-attempt-1.png, not at the requested runs path, because the tool blocked that path.

review.summary: reset() sets the counter to 0, the button is wired to it in index.html next to the existing controls, and a meaningful test covers it. Nothing unrelated is touched. The test suite could not be run in this session, so the verdict is based on reading the code.
